host.description: OPC UA server hostname or IP address

endpointUrl.description: Full OPC UA endpoint URL (e.g. opc.tcp://host:4840). If empty, constructed from host:port.

securityPolicy.description: Security policy URI for the secure channel

securityMode.description: Message security mode for the secure channel

requestedPublishingInterval.description: Requested publishing interval for subscriptions in milliseconds

connectionSummary: Connects to an OPC UA server via opc.tcp:// transport. Performs HEL/ACK handshake followed by OpenSecureChannel (OPN) with SecurityPolicy#None. Supports Browse, Read, Write, CreateSubscription, CreateMonitoredItems, and Publish services for full address space exploration and data access.
connectionSteps: Set the target OPC UA server host and TCP port (default: 4840).
Engine sends HEL (Hello) message and waits for ACK (Acknowledge) from the server.
Engine sends OPN (Open Secure Channel) request with SecurityPolicy#None and receives a SecureChannelId and TokenId.
With the secure channel established, Browse/Read/Write/Subscribe operations are available via capability actions.
On disconnect, a CLO (Close Secure Channel) message is sent for clean teardown.
readBehavior: Read sends an OPC UA ReadRequest for the Value attribute (attributeId=13) of the specified NodeId(s). The address field accepts comma-separated NodeId strings (e.g. 'i=2258' or 'ns=2;s=MyNode'). Response contains the DataValue with value, statusCode, and timestamps.
writeBehavior: Write sends an OPC UA WriteRequest for the Value attribute. The address field accepts comma-separated NodeId strings. The data field contains raw bytes interpreted as Int32 (4 bytes), Int16 (2 bytes), or Boolean (1 byte).
